text:
dana: Heads up — automated scanner flagged a crypto issue: some legacy certs signed with deprecated algorithm on ingress nodes in us-east and eu-west. CVE notice attached. Need triage (mTLS + audit) :eyes:
lee: Oncall here, what's the exact list of hosts?
dana: Scanner output (abbreviated):
```
proxy-ingress-prod-us-east-1
proxy-ingress-staging-eu-west-2
edge-legacy-1.us-east.internal
```
All show signature algorithm: sha1WithRSAEncryption and non-AIA chain.
sarah: Ugh, sha1-certs. Are these from the old cert-rotator or customer-provided?
alex: I checked rotator logs — the rotator service rotated most in Jan but there was a failure for edge-legacy-1 and the code fell back to a legacy store (commit 5f3a2b). Possibly the rotator IAM role lacked kms:Decrypt for that key.
dana: Can we confirm KMS unwrap logs for the rotator principal? Need audit trail for who triggered and whether RBAC change caused it.
lee: ops-bot, pull KG logs for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/rotator-main for 2026-03-18..2026-03-20
ops-bot: @lee Requested logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/kg/rotator-main/2026-03-18_2026-03-20 (authorized users only) :lock:
ops-bot: KMS UnwrapCount: 12, UnwrapErrors: 1 (2026-03-19T03:14:22Z)
sarah: That error timestamp matches the rotator failure. Who changed the rotator role last week?
alex: IAM change recorded in ACL audit: removed policy kms:Decrypt from role cert-rotator-service at 2026-03-19T02:59Z by infra-ci (automation). Change PR: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/PR-892
lee: If automation removed it, we need to fix the automation rule and re-run rotator. Also need to mark this as an incident and capture audit evidence for compliance.
dana: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) temporarily re-grant kms:Decrypt to cert-rotator-service, 2) re-run rotator for affected hosts, 3) generate short-lived replacement certs for edge-legacy-1, 4) backfill audit logs and prepare evidence.
sarah: Add checks: fail rotator job if any fallback to legacy keystore occurs, and emit a telemetry event `rotator.fallback.legacy_keystore` with host tag.
lee: I'll run the minimal patch to re-add kms:Decrypt (iam change will be manual and recorded). Patch command we used in internal-cli:
```
redwood-iam grant --role cert-rotator-service --action kms:Decrypt --resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/rotator-main --reason "temp restore for incident INC-2310"
```
I will add a comment linking to the issue.
dana: When rotator runs, confirm TLS chain uses sha256 signatures. Use quick check:
```
openssl s_client -connect proxy-ingress-prod-us-east-1:443 -servername proxy | openssl x509 -noout -text | grep -i "Signature Algorithm"
```
Expect: Signature Algorithm: sha256WithRSAEncryption
alex: Also ensure we capture the KMS audit event IDs and include them in the incident packet. Ops-bot, can you snapshot the KMS event id for the failure?
ops-bot: KMS Event ID: kmsevt-20260319-031422-7a9f. Linked in logs.
sarah: For compliance, add a note: certs signed >10 years or using sha1 must be escalated. Create a recurring check job in observability: cert.policy.check -> emits alert if signature contains "sha1" or validity > 3650 days.
dana: I'll file INC-2310 and assign postmortem owners. Also need to check east-west mTLS between services — some internal clients might cache old certs. Add a KV cache invalidation step in rollout.
lee: Rolling now to staging, then prod canary. Will post status.
sarah: QA checklist: ensure no broken handshakes (samples: proxy->edge-legacy-1, edge-legacy-1->backend). Test commands and include failing TLS debug logs if any.
dana: Thanks. Follow-ups: - infra to fix automation PR (alex) - ops to run rotations (lee) - security to assemble audit packet for compliance (sarah) - create observability rule for signature algorithm (dana)
alex: I'll revert automation change and open a hotfix PR, tagging infra-oncall.
lee: staging rotation succeeded: replaced certs now show sha256. Prod canary scheduled in 10m.
dana: Good. Keep this thread updated with timestamps and KMS event ids. We'll close when audit packet uploaded to https://vault.redwood/incidents/INC-2310. :white_check_mark:
